propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking diagnostic to verify that mapped Jira project keys and legacy_default in .bridge_state/projects.json are actually visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass.

The bridge fsck command must gain an optional --live-visibility flag that performs a live read-only visibility check against configured Jira credentials without mutating bridge state or altering the exit contract.
When JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, or JIRA_API_TOKEN are absent or incomplete and no probe is injected for testing, the visibility check must gracefully skip with an advisory verdict rather than fail.
The visibility check must reuse the shared helper check_mapped_project_visibility from access_check.py (used by reconcile pass) to avoid duplicating existence-check logic.
The advisory verdict must be rendered to stderr as human-readable lines in both text and JSON output modes without modifying the stdout JSON schema or adding new required fields.
The core rebar doctor command must remain Jira-free with no new imports of reconciler or agents optional extras reachable from _commands/doctor.py.
